text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's finally starting~. Fufu, I'm looking 
forward to seeing what kind of race it'll 
be.
choice_data_list: You seem to have plenty of leeway.
You seem to have plenty of leeway.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Always stay calm and keep your 
composure. Panicking won't lead to good 
results, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That said— it's not like I have no 
fighting spirit, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It is not something to display, but to 
harbor within. Even now, it burns quietly 
and fiercely in my chest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Preparations are complete. Calm and 
collected, I shall go and seize victory♪
